name: भारतीय रेल समय-सारणी / शेड्यूल (Indian Railways Train Schedules)
title: भारतीय रेल समय-सारणी / शेड्यूल (Indian Railways Train Schedules)
description: 62,123 train-station halts from the Indian Railways IRCTC NTES public timetable database, covering 2,858 trains and 3,343 stations. Each record is a single halt (train × station) with serial number in the route, scheduled arrival/departure/halt times, cumulative distance from origin (km), and day-of-journey (Day-1 = departure day). Source: BhanuTeella/Indian-Railways-Data (CC0-1.0), a 2023-02 snapshot of IRCTC NTES timetable data. Origin halts have arrival/halt = "--"; terminus halts have departure/halt = "--". Route Number = 1 for the standard route; values > 1 indicate diversion/alternate-route variants. Sister datasets: hi-trains (2,858 trains), hi-railway-stations (3,343 stations).
